name: s4_sparse
description: Objective-only arm (D252 audit): touchdown 0.4, win 0.6, draw -0.1 for both sides, every dense shaping term off. Exists to test, from a capable warm start, whether the 12-term s0_both economy (94% of reward mass, TD step net -0.56 to the scorer under exact PBRS) is helping or hurting. reward_dist_pbrs_gamma is kept at the training gamma so the manifest gate that requires equality still passes; with both distance coefficients at zero it has no effect.
